production_permission: SHADOW_STABLE_PASS[capability] AND FORWARD_GATE[capability] AND MIGRATION_REPLAY_PASS[capability] AND all_required_dependency_permissions

shadow_stable_gate.parameter_or_model_change: reset affected capability window; shared dependency change resets all consumers

stock_forward_gate.quality: OBSERVED only; estimated outcomes do not satisfy gate

sector_and_rotation_forward_gates.counting: per type; unique episodes and dates; failure included but cannot satisfy positive accepted-event count; pulse cannot substitute accepted; same episode event types not summed as unique episodes

benchmark_missing_and_consumer_policy.unknown_or_missing: no carry/no zero/no drop; retain reason and original weights
benchmark_missing_and_consumer_policy.OBSERVED: all included weights have verified actual endpoint or contract-qualified terminal value on common evaluation basis; observed relative consumer only
benchmark_missing_and_consumer_policy.MARKED_ESTIMATE: separate output only when verified suspension carry price is same-basis and V4_BENCHMARK_MINIMUM_ENDPOINT_WEIGHT_COVERAGE and V4_BENCHMARK_MAXIMUM_SUSPENSION_QUOTE_AGE have accepted values and pass; never relabel OBSERVED
benchmark_missing_and_consumer_policy.PARTIAL_UNVALUED: complete relative return unavailable; observed contribution diagnostic; absolute outcome and independent capabilities continue

rollback.candidate_head_activation: only after capability-specific receipt passes; atomic compare-and-swap against frozen predecessor
rollback.failure_action: keep prior accepted head; mark failed capability/date/entity/field and reason; no partial acceptance
rollback.scope: Phase 0 schema/config/code rollback; data rollback begins before V4 shadow/production.

restore_drill.reason: Old PostgreSQL business rows are not V4 migration assets; no data restore is needed for Phase 0. Physical backup was retained at the explicit user request.

schema_rebuild_drill.failed_migration_atomicity: PostgreSQL transactional DDL; schema-only rollback and fresh reapply verified before V4 rows existed.
